defs.def: the abbreviation for ‘physical education’ (sport and exercise that is taught in schools) 体育（课）（全写为 physical education）

ex.s: In her first PE class , Eva was shocked when Coach Pitt announced that everyone had to run one mile around the track outside.
ex.t: 在第一节体育课上，伊娃震惊地发现皮特教练宣布每个人都必须绕着外面的跑道跑一英里。

ex.s: As a peer group, you decide what is covered in each session.
ex.t: 作为同伴小组，你们决定每次活动涵盖什么内容。

ex.s: I'll finish my high school education here.
ex.t: 我将在这里完成我的高中学业。

ex.s: It involves doing very slow physical exercises to relax your mind and calm your body.
ex.t: 它涉及做非常缓慢的身体练习，以放松你的头脑，平静你的身体。

ex.s: I think the support which is needed includes new technology for recycling water and education on how to use and save water.
ex.t: 我认为所需支持包括循环用水的新技术和关于如何用水和节水的教育。

ex.s: Its artist, Han Gan, is known for his skill in capturing not only the physical features of the animal, but also its inner spirit and strength.
ex.t: 其艺术家韩甘以不仅能捕捉动物的物理特征，而且能捕捉其内在精神和力量而闻名。
